description.en: For DSC PowerSeries and Honeywell / Ademco Vista alarm panels fitted with an Envisalink EVL-3 or EVL-4 module, on your network, without the EyezOn cloud: the state of each partition (disarmed, armed away, stay or night, in alarm, ready), the zones (open or closed, alarm, tamper, fault), the system troubles (mains, battery, tamper), panic alarms, arming from Gladys and scene triggers. The module accepts one local connection (TPI, TCP port 4025) at a time: stop any other software using it (Home Assistant, another Gladys). Unofficial, not affiliated with EyezOn, DSC or Honeywell.
